target_description.en: Find files and folders on a Windows computer by typing part of their names, without opening drives and folders one by one.
target_description.zh-CN: 输入文件名或其中几个字，就能快速找到 Windows 电脑里的文件和文件夹，不用逐个磁盘翻找。

summary.en: A native macOS filename search application written in Swift and C, with indexing, search operators and filesystem updates.
summary.zh-CN: Swift 与 C 编写的 macOS 原生文件名搜索工具，包含索引、搜索语法和文件变更更新。

rea.en: Documents REA 6.4.0 and Ghidra analysis of the shipped Everything executable to inform the search design.
rea.zh-CN: 记录了使用 REA 6.4.0 与 Ghidra 分析 Everything 发行程序，并据此设计搜索功能。

limitations.en: An independent macOS implementation; its reported benchmarks have not been reproduced by this catalog.
limitations.zh-CN: 属于独立的 macOS 实现；本目录未复现作者报告的性能数据。

target_description.en: A macOS screen recorder that adds automatic zoom, smooth cursor movement and polished backgrounds to turn demonstrations and tutorials into shareable videos.
target_description.zh-CN: macOS 录屏工具，可自动放大操作区域、美化光标和背景，帮助用户制作软件演示、教程与产品介绍视频。

summary.en: A Rust macOS screen recorder and editor with automatic zoom, cursor animation, captions and video export.
summary.zh-CN: Rust 编写的 macOS 录屏与编辑工具，包含自动缩放、光标动画、字幕和视频导出。

rea.en: REA analyzed the Electron application graph and Mach-O helper inventory; the native helpers were not decompiled.
rea.zh-CN: REA 分析了 Electron 应用图和 Mach-O 辅助程序结构，但未反编译原生辅助程序。

limitations.en: Live camera and iOS capture have unverified paths; this is a reconstruction of observed behavior.
limitations.zh-CN: 摄像头与 iOS 实录仍有未验证路径；项目重建的是观察到的行为。

target_description.en: A Windows translation tool that sends selected or typed text to online translation services and offers convenient popups, pronunciation and translation history.
target_description.zh-CN: Windows 翻译工具，可将选中或输入的文字交给在线翻译服务，提供便捷弹窗、发音和翻译历史。

summary.en: A Python translation client with provider plugins, popup UI, hotkeys, history and text-to-speech.
summary.zh-CN: Python 翻译客户端，包含服务插件、弹窗、快捷键、历史与文字朗读。

rea.en: REA with Ghidra checked plugin loading and theme parsing, including a documented correction of an earlier interpretation.
rea.zh-CN: REA 与 Ghidra 用于核对插件加载和主题解析，并留下对早期判断的纠错记录。

limitations.en: REA was introduced during an existing reconstruction; visual parity remains incomplete and translation depends on external providers.
limitations.zh-CN: REA 在已有重建过程中加入；视觉一致性尚未完成，翻译依赖外部服务。

target_description.en: DJ software for organizing music, analyzing tracks, preparing cue points and playlists, and performing mixes with compatible DJ equipment.
target_description.zh-CN: 面向 DJ 的音乐管理与演出软件，用于整理曲库、分析歌曲、设置提示点和播放列表，并配合设备混音演出。

summary.en: A Rust and Tauri DJ library manager with rekordbox import, waveform browsing and dual-player work.
summary.zh-CN: Rust 与 Tauri DJ 音乐库工具，已开展 rekordbox 导入、波形浏览和双播放器实现。

rea.en: The author explicitly credits REA with Ghidra for studying rekordbox; the public notes also draw on established community research.
rea.zh-CN: 作者明确记录用 REA 与 Ghidra 研究 rekordbox，同时采用已有社区研究成果。

limitations.en: Pre-alpha, with no key lock and several deck features unfinished; full REA invocation evidence is not published.
limitations.zh-CN: 处于早期原型阶段，变速不变调及多项播放器功能未完成；未公开完整 REA 调用证据。

target_description.en: A collaborative planning tool that organizes tasks into boards, lists and cards so teams can assign work, set deadlines and track progress.
target_description.zh-CN: 团队任务与项目管理工具，用看板、列表和卡片组织工作，便于分配负责人、设置截止时间并跟踪进度。

summary.en: A self-hosted team board application with cards, permissions, realtime updates, table and calendar views.
summary.zh-CN: 自托管团队看板，包含卡片、权限、实时同步、表格与日历视图。

rea.en: REA inspected Trello page structure, client scripts and network shapes during recorded behavior research.
rea.zh-CN: REA 在有记录的行为研究中观察 Trello 页面结构、客户端脚本和网络数据形状。

limitations.en: The backend is independently designed; server-side Trello source was not recovered, and long-running team use is untested.
limitations.zh-CN: 后端为独立设计，未恢复 Trello 服务端源码，也未完成长期团队使用验证。

target_description.en: A market charting platform for following asset prices, applying technical indicators, drawing chart annotations and maintaining watchlists across different financial markets.
target_description.zh-CN: 金融行情与图表平台，可查看不同市场的价格走势、叠加技术指标、绘制图表标记，并管理自选关注列表。

summary.en: A Rust market-data terminal informed by TradingView chart interactions, layouts, shortcuts and paging.
summary.zh-CN: 参考 TradingView 图表交互、布局、快捷键和分页方式实现的 Rust 行情终端。

rea.en: Website-mode REA captures of the public chart page are listed with evidence IDs and observation limits.
rea.zh-CN: 列出 REA 网站模式对公开图表页的捕获证据 ID 与观察限制。

limitations.en: This is behavior research, not recovery of TradingView source or a Bloomberg binary.
limitations.zh-CN: 属于行为研究，未恢复 TradingView 源码，也未逆向 Bloomberg 二进制。

target_description.en: Chinese astrology and divination services that generate birth charts, interpret fortunes and offer AI conversations about personality, relationships, careers and daily life.
target_description.zh-CN: 基于八字等传统命理提供排盘、运势解读和 AI 对话，用于浏览个人性格、关系、事业与日常生活主题的解读。

summary.en: A calendar-calculation and streaming-dialog backend prototype developed after studying two web products.
summary.zh-CN: 研究两个网站产品后实现的历法计算与流式对话后端原型。

rea.en: Documents REA browser captures, script exports and partial application graphs, with conclusions tied to retained observations.
rea.zh-CN: 记录 REA 浏览器捕获、脚本导出和部分应用图，并把结论对应到保留的观察记录。

limitations.en: Frontend observations informed a new backend; the original server implementation was not recovered.
limitations.zh-CN: 根据前端观察另行实现后端，未恢复原服务端实现。

target_description.en: A music transcription and practice tool that slows recordings without changing pitch, loops passages and helps musicians identify notes and chords by ear.
target_description.zh-CN: 放慢录音而不改变音高，还能反复播放小片段，帮助乐手听清音符和和弦、记录乐谱或练习演奏。

summary.en: A Swift macOS music-practice application with waveforms, looping, markers, spectrum views and speed control.
summary.zh-CN: Swift macOS 音乐练习工具，包含波形、循环、标记、频谱和速度控制。

rea.en: REA inspected the bundle and Mach-O metadata; deep native providers were unavailable and produced no pseudocode.
rea.zh-CN: REA 检查了应用包和 Mach-O 元数据；原生深度分析引擎不可用，未产生伪代码。

limitations.en: The rebuild also uses bundled help and runtime observations; its slowdown uses Apple TimePitch, not the original private algorithm.
limitations.zh-CN: 重建还依据内置帮助和运行时观察；减速使用 Apple TimePitch，未恢复原版私有算法。

target_description.en: A Windows industrial communication tester for reading and changing Modbus device values, monitoring data and diagnosing communication problems during setup and development.
target_description.zh-CN: Windows 工业通信测试工具，可读取和修改 Modbus 设备数据、持续监视变化，帮助调试设备与排查通信问题。

summary.en: A Rust Modbus master and monitor with conditional colors, charts and a SCADA-style dashboard.
summary.zh-CN: Rust Modbus 主站与监控工具，包含条件着色、曲线和 SCADA 风格面板。

rea.en: REA opened the target, but subsequent MCP queries failed schema validation; the author documented a local interface fix.
rea.zh-CN: REA 成功打开目标，但后续 MCP 查询因输出结构验证失败；作者记录了本地接口修复。

limitations.en: The color-engine analysis used Capstone independently of REA; TLS, printing and some integrations remain unfinished.
limitations.zh-CN: 颜色引擎分析使用独立于 REA 的 Capstone；TLS、打印及部分集成尚未完成。

target_description.en: An online fantasy role-playing game where players explore a shared world, complete quests, develop characters and tackle dungeons or battles with others.
target_description.zh-CN: 大型多人在线奇幻角色扮演游戏，玩家可探索世界、完成任务、培养角色，并与他人组队挑战副本或参与对战。

summary.en: A Godot single-player scene prototype with data-extraction tools.
summary.zh-CN: Godot 单机场景原型，并公开数据提取工具。

rea.en: REA identified the binary, but native analysis timed out and the project moved to direct Ghidra analysis.
rea.zh-CN: REA 完成二进制身份识别，但原生分析超时，项目随后改用直接 Ghidra 分析。

limitations.en: Neither a full WoW client nor evidence that REA recovered the game's logic; original game resources are separate.
limitations.zh-CN: 不是完整魔兽客户端，也不能证明 REA 恢复了游戏逻辑；原版游戏资源另计。
